svg.aria-label: Causal order broadcast: A message waits until everything its sender had seen has been delivered here too.. ⟨question, vector clock⟩; same message, arrives quickly; ⟨answer, vector clock includes the question⟩; the answer arrives first: hold it back; the question arrives: deliver both, in order. The vector clock names what the sender had seen, so nothing is delivered before its cause.
